quarterly_data.quarter: Teradyne press release: Teradyne Announces Magnum E2 to Address Next-Generation (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Teradyne announced Magnum E2, a next-generation high-speed memory test system for advanced DRAM and flash interfaces including LPDDR6, DDR6, GDDR7 and NAND flash, built on its Near-DUT Test (NDT) architecture (the foundation of the Magnum EPIC platform). It supports production and engineering configurations from qualification through high-volume manufacturing on common hardware and software; supports NRZ, PAM3 and PAM4 signaling with a programmable APG architecture; and adds built-in logic test so memory and logic test run on one platform. The company says DRAM and flash are moving to higher speeds with wide I/O and PAM3 signaling, demanding greater pin count and parallelism. Memory Test division president Ben Han: customers 'cannot afford a test platform that forces a choice between signal integrity and throughput'. No customers, shipment or availability date stated.
